verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party bulk data export or account-exit capability in open formats. The REST API, OpenAPI spec, status-page JSON API and MCP server are developer building blocks someone could use to build an export. Exporting a single retrospective copy to an external editor is an adjacent, narrow feature, not an export of all data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
